title: A whole exchange promises no eternal unity

captions.physics: Completing disagreement with actual conclusions named
captions.energy: Encompassing agreement alongside its real limit

meaning: You can complete disagreement with a conclusion named and encompass agreement alongside its limit, noticing attachment to guaranteed unanimity without making it genuine understanding’s condition.
text: On your Vishuddha, the World in the physical position appears in completing disagreement with an actual conclusion named. The World in energy supports a wish to encompass agreement alongside its limit. The Devil in emotions brings attachment to guaranteed unanimity. You can genuinely understand a question and still want reassurance beyond what was accepted. Understanding the present question does not settle every future difference.

For example, an argument about generalisations ends clearly: in this exchange “You always answer like that” becomes one particular occasion. Today’s question gains a whole conclusion, but “We will never argue again” is also wanted. **Actual understanding needs no guarantee of eternal agreement**. You can acknowledge this pull without cancelling achievement. Yet an absent unlimited promise does not empty correction of meaning: particular acceptance remains genuine without determining every future different assessment or uncomfortable intonation.

Difficulty grows if no conclusion feels complete without a wanted promise about the entire future. Wholeness is expanded into an unattainable scope. Constructive World energy helps encompass actual agreement without added boundlessness. You can finish a question and still want greater certainty; attachment need not disappear immediately, but does not make future differences breaches of today’s word or proof that the present exchange clarified nothing.
